import hashlib, io, os
U="/home/faisal/EventMarketDB-driver-recovery/a7_recovery/unit_1773"
def dd(d):
    L=[]
    for b,_x,fs in os.walk(d):
        for n in fs:
            p=os.path.join(b,n); h=hashlib.sha256(io.open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
            L.append("%s  ./%s\n"%(h,os.path.relpath(p,d)))
    return hashlib.sha256("".join(sorted(L)).encode()).hexdigest(), len(L)
for v in ("view/workflows","view/subagent_runs"):
    print("%s %s %s"%((v,)+dd(os.path.join(U,v))))
